name: Colossos - Kampf der Giganten
description: One of Europe's most legendary wooden roller coasters — Colossos stands 58 metres tall and reaches 120 km/h, making it one of the tallest and fastest wooden coasters ever built. Constructed by Intamin using prefabricated wooden track sections, Colossos was a genuine engineering marvel when it opened in 2001 and held multiple world records. Recently reimagined with a spectacular dark narrative about giants fighting underground forces, the ride now features dramatic lighting and sound effects that make the experience even more intense than before. The combination of sheer height, thundering wooden structure and remarkable speed makes Colossos an unmissable European bucket-list coaster. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Flug der Damonen
description: Germany's first Wing Coaster — Flight of the Demons — is a spectacular B&M masterpiece standing 40 metres tall and delivering five inversions including the unique Demonic Knot element found nowhere else on earth. Riders sit in pairs extending beyond both sides of the track with nothing above or below their feet as the coaster tears through its beautifully themed demonic landscape at 4.7G. The atmospheric IMAscore soundtrack and dark theming make Flug der Damonen one of the most immersive and exciting wing coasters in Europe. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Krake
description: Germany's first Dive Coaster — a B&M masterpiece that hauls riders to a terrifying height above Heide Park Lake before holding them suspended over a vertical drop for agonising seconds before plunging straight down at 120 km/h. The aquatic Krake monster theme is brilliantly realised with a submerged shipwreck visible from the top of the lift hill. With dangling feet and nothing but water below, the anticipation at the crest is almost unbearable. An absolutely world-class coaster experience. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Desert Race
description: Germany's first hydraulic launch coaster — an Intamin Accelerator that fires riders from 0 to 100 km/h in under 2 seconds, generating forces comparable to a Formula 1 car launch. Desert Race rockets along its desert-themed layout through hills and over the iconic top hat element before returning to the station with hearts still pounding. The launch is genuinely shocking in its violence and makes Desert Race one of the most intense single experiences in German theme parks. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Limit
description: A classic Vekoma suspended looping coaster that pushes riders to the limit through five inversions with feet dangling freely beneath the track. Limit was Germany's first suspended looping coaster and despite being one of the older attractions at Heide Park still delivers a genuinely thrilling and disorienting experience that keeps guests returning. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Big Loop
description: A classic Vekoma looping coaster that sends riders through two loops and a double corkscrew — four inversions in total — on a ride that turns your world upside down four times as you descend from 30 metres. Located near Heide Park's beautiful lake, Big Loop is one of the most photogenic coasters in the park and delivers a satisfying classic looper experience. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Scream
description: A terrifying giant drop tower that lifts riders to a spectacular height before dropping them in a stomach-churning freefall — one of Heide Park's most screamed-about attractions. Scream towers above the park and can be seen from almost everywhere, building dread long before riders reach the top. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Sturmfahrt
description: A classic river rapids ride delivering exciting white water thrills and guaranteed soakings as circular rafts carry groups through rushing channels, waterfalls and unexpected splashes. Sturmfahrt is one of Heide Park's most popular summer attractions and a firm family favourite — the unpredictable splashing keeps everyone laughing throughout. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Bobbahn
description: One of the world's largest Mack bobsled coasters — a spectacular 3,250-foot long bobsled run that winds, banks and swoops through the park at thrilling speeds. Bobbahn is one of Heide Park's most beloved classic attractions and delivers a unique sensation quite unlike any other ride in the park. Min. height: 110cm.

name: Ghostbusters 5D
description: An exciting 5D interactive dark ride where guests join the Ghostbusters team to hunt and blast ghosts through a series of animated scenes using special blasters. Ghostbusters 5D is one of the most popular family attractions at Heide Park and provides a genuinely fun competitive experience as riders compete for the highest ghost-busting score. Suitable for all ages.

name: Grottenblitz
description: A classic log flume ride winding through atmospheric dark caverns and grottos before delivering a splashing final drop that guarantees a thorough soaking. Grottenblitz is one of the most beloved family attractions at Heide Park and a must-ride on any warm day — the enclosed grotto sections create a magical dark atmosphere before the big finale. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Wilde Maus
description: A classic wild mouse coaster delivering sharp hairpin turns and unexpected drops in a compact layout that packs genuine surprises into every corner. Wilde Maus is one of the most accessible thrill rides at Heide Park and a firm favourite with families — fast enough to excite older children while remaining manageable for younger riders. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Indy Blitz
description: A family roller coaster themed to adventure and exploration, delivering exciting twists and turns in an accessible package that is perfect for families with older children seeking their first real coaster thrills. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Bounty Land
description: A spectacular pirate-themed area at the heart of Heide Park featuring the swinging Bounty ship attraction alongside live pirate shows, themed restaurants and a beautifully designed harbour setting. The Bounty Land area is one of the most atmospheric sections of the park and home to the famous Tortuga pirate show that delights audiences of all ages. Min. height: 120cm for ship ride.

name: Panoramabahn
description: A relaxing scenic railway that loops through the entire Heide Park Resort offering beautiful elevated views over the park, the lake and the surrounding Luneburg Heath landscape. Panoramabahn is the perfect attraction for families with very young children or for anyone wanting a gentle break between the major thrill rides. Suitable for all ages.
